g.text: Guarded routing: one route group under first-match and all-match
only if A's guard was false
every true guard emits one child token;
more than one emission mints a fork epoch
Trigger filtering precedes guard evaluation: a failed
activity can never traverse a completed route merely
because its predicate is true. Groups of one disposition
all fire in the same Route microstep, each with its own
selection; an unobserved Rholang guard anywhere among
them blocks the whole token until its observation lands.
